input.final_summary: `get_node("NoirPaletteOverlay/FilterRect")` fails in **1.1** because the overlay was dropped from the scene while the script still references it. **1.2** and `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` are structurally correct. Best fix: re-instance the overlay in `1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn` (low risk).

content.text:
## Root cause

**Scene–script mismatch in 1.1 only.** Both scripts bind the same path:

```6:6:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.1_SchoolExterior.gd
@onready var _noir_filter_rect: ColorRect = $NoirPaletteOverlay/FilterRect
```

```6:6:c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.2_Corridor.gd
@onready var _noir_filter_rect: ColorRect = $NoirPaletteOverlay/FilterRect
```

`@onready` resolves at enter-tree — before `_ready()` — so a missing node aborts the whole script.

| File | Has `NoirPaletteOverlay`? | Has `FilterRect`? |
|------|---------------------------|-------------------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn` | **No** | **No** |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.2_Corridor.tscn` | Yes (line 309) | Yes (via instance) |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\fx\NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` | Root `CanvasLayer` | Child `FilterRect` (line 13) |

**1.1 scene ends at `TopDialogueOverlay` only** — no noir ext_resource, no overlay node. Changelog says it was preserved during the background swap, but the current `.tscn` dropped it (ScanlineOverlay is also missing vs changelog). QA already logged this: `plans\qa\AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md`.

**1.2 should not hit this error** — instance path is valid. Note: 1.2 still has `scale = Vector2(1.12, 1.12)` on the overlay (line 310), which changelog said was removed; visual issue only, not a path failure.

---

## Candidate fixes (risk)

| Fix | Risk | Notes |
|-----|------|-------|
| **Re-instance `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` in `1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn`** (mirror 1.2 line 309) | **Low** | Restores intended stack; `_USE_LOCAL_NOIR_TUNING := true` works again |
| **Set `_USE_LOCAL_NOIR_TUNING := false` + remove `@onready _noir_filter_rect`** in `1.1_SchoolExterior.gd` | **Low** (crash) / **Med** (visual) | Stops error; 1.1 runs without noir filter |
| **Replace `@onready` with `get_node_or_null()` + null guard** in `_apply_local_noir_tuning()` | **Low** (crash) / **Med** (visual) | Silent skip; same unfiltered look as above |
| **Runtime `add_child(load(...NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn).instantiate())`** from script | **Med** | Works but layer/order/tuning timing harder to maintain in editor |
| **Move tuning into `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` or scene export vars** | **Med–High** | Cross-scene behavior change; 1.2 has its own tuning path |
| **Change path** (e.g. `%FilterRect` unique name) | **Low** only if node exists | **Does not fix 1.1** — node is absent, not misnamed |

**Recommended:** Re-add the overlay instance to `1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn` — lowest risk, matches 1.2 and `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` contract.
